selection: SHA256 order salted with reel-acoustic-confirmation-v1/. Eight development clips, then 20 confirmation clips. At least three distinct audio references and 4–75 seconds. Previously published or locally panelled IDs excluded. Model pretraining overlap unknown.

upstream.protocol: Eight-second turns. Each turn uses its recent windows if available, otherwise its wider windows. Equal weight per distinct active channel group and window within each clip, then equal weight per clip. Sentence cosine against own human references minus average other film references. Relative to held-out human separation.

reader.model: Local signed-in Codex gpt-6.1-terra. Fresh session per film and arm. No raw audio blocks to GPT. Open-ended recall after viewing all turns, eight seconds per turn. Output images and time bounds matched byte-for-byte. For the first comparison baseline first on even indices, reranking first on odd indices. MOSS and identity follow-ups were run later on the same twelve films. Identity adds two-model AudioSet rankings on top of checked captions. Its score field is labelled as a within-model score in all final reader sessions.
